text:
Aisha T.: hi team, onboarding a customer sample app (node + python) and hit a weird mismatch: node SDK returns 4 embeddings for a 5-input request when batch_helper is on and transient auth retry happens. python returns all 5.

Marco B.: can you paste a tiny repro and the raw http sequence? sounds like a batching reassembly bug.

Aisha T.: repro gist (sanitized):
```js
// node
await client.embeddings.create({
  model: 'embed-compact-v1',
  input: ['a','b','c','d','e'],
  batch_helper: {enabled: true, max_batch_size: 3}
})
```
server logs show: 200, 200, then a 401 for a sub-batch which triggers client retry. final node response array has 4 vectors.

Linh Q.: known pattern: node helper used positional stitching to save bytes; if a replayed sub-batch returns fewer items (server-side dedupe on replay) the index-based merge drops items. python uses per-item ids so it's safe.

Ken S.: short-term workaround: set batch_helper.tag_ids=true in node or disable the helper. also try adding header `X-Response-Shape: object_items` to opt into object items from server.

Aisha T.: tried tag_ids=true, parity fixed. but onboarding docs don't mention tag_ids clearly; this tripped the customer. can we add a note in quickstart?

Marco B.: yes, add doc note under "Batching helper" -> when to enable tag_ids (auth/retry, at-least-once semantics). also we'll change default to auto-enable tagging when retries are configured.

DevEx Bot: Created DEVEX-4999: "node SDK: auto-enable batch item tags when retry/backoff enabled + docs note"  https://rwd.in/DEVEX-4999

Linh Q.: server-side follow-up: we'll add `meta.dedupe_count` when server collapses replayed items and a `meta.sub_batch_id` echo so clients can trace mismatches. low-risk and helps debugging.

Ken S.: migration plan for response shape: opt-in header for one release, then flip default after two releases with compatibility flag. update samples in both SDKs simultaneously.

Aisha T.: filing a quickstart PR and adding a minimal repro snippet to DEVEX-4999. thanks for the triage! :pray:
